dsh-archive-viewer is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Archived-session manager for the DSH Web GUI: search titles and message content, tag/filter sessions, read logs, restore sessions, and export ZIP archives.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-e4b7245efb3331bcf6f4.html
